sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.8 Locally: 27B on 16-24GB GPUs (2026)
sources.snippet: What are you actually running? Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model: text, images, and video (including hour-scale video) in one checkpoint, Apache-2.0 licensed. Native context is 262,144 tokens — the "extensible up to 1,000,000" line on the card refers to a Qwen Cloud hosted feature that is "coming soon", so plan around 256K locally.
